issues.basis: The NL6 termination contract names FinishState as the ending target. The closed model binds FinishState exactly, but that target has an outgoing auto_finished transition to the enclosing completion boundary, so the designated ending target does not provide stable termination semantics.
issues.expected: HighwayMode must terminate by reaching a stable FinishState completion target.
issues.observed: FinishState is reachable, but it has outgoing transitions transition:line:36 and transition:line:40 on auto_finished_true to the enclosing boundary, so the target can continue through the enclosing hierarchy rather than remaining a stable completion state.
issues.reason: This evaluates the termination property itself. Endpoint existence is present, but the exact target has continued behavior in the closed model, which prevents the named termination target from being stable.
issues.requirement_quote: The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState is the exact source-grounded target and the model has a HighwayMode-to-completion route, so the issue would be defeated only if the enclosing-boundary transitions were defined as formal completion rather than continued behavior; the supplied model facts retain those outgoing transitions.
issues.title: Highway completion target is not stable

issues.basis: The NL10 termination contract names FinishState as the ending target for UrbanMode. The exact closed target is nested under HighwayMode and has outgoing completion-boundary transitions, so reaching it does not establish stable termination of the UrbanMode behavior.
issues.expected: UrbanMode must terminate by reaching a stable FinishState completion target.
issues.observed: The UrbanMode completion route is encoded through the exact FinishState under HighwayMode, and FinishState has outgoing auto_finished_true transitions transition:line:36 and transition:line:40 to the enclosing boundary.
issues.reason: This preserves the stronger termination contract separately from the endpoint contract. The model can route to the named FinishState, but the target ancestry continues through enclosing behavior instead of being a stable terminal configuration.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source and model both identify FinishState as the completion target, and the route-control macro may be intended to represent completion; however, the supplied closed inventory still records outgoing target-boundary behavior from FinishState.
issues.title: Urban completion target is not stable
